hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: Convert the string to lowercase so uppercase and lowercase versions of the same letter are treated identically.

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: Compare each adjacent pair of characters s[i] and s[i - 1].

hints.title: Algorithmic Steps
hints.text: Count each index where the lowercase character changes from the previous character.

hints.title: Implementation

variables: n: length of input string s
complexity.notes: Single pass adjacent character comparison ignoring case.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Re-scanning substrings creates unnecessary quadratic passes.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use case normalization to verify consecutive key identity.
